styles.quirky: Quirky painterly caricature illustration for a maths game for 11 to 13 year olds, loose expressive digital oil brushwork, visible textured strokes, exaggerated grotesque-funny proportions with big noses, bulging eyes and lumpy shapes, gritty detailed characters, earthy muted palette with pops of red and orange, sky-blue painterly background, humorous and grown-up, not cute, not babyish, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.

pictures.name: card
pictures.prompt: A cosy little retro take-away diner at night seen from the street, warm glowing windows, a red and white striped awning, a blank shop sign with no writing, a chunky brown paper take-away bag and a curly paper order ticket sitting on the front counter, a kiwi bird chef in a white hat working behind the counter, a calm deep-blue evening sky with a few stars at the top, wide landscape picture for a title card, the diner in the middle.

pictures.name: back-diner
pictures.prompt: Inside a bright friendly retro diner kitchen seen straight on from the customer side: a long clean pale counter across the bottom, a big plain pale-cream wall in the middle with a few simple shelves of jars and plates near the edges, a round wall clock, checkered tiles at the very top edge, the middle of the wall empty and calm so things placed on top stand out. Completely empty background scenery, absolutely no people, no characters, no faces, nobody at the counter, soft muted colours in the middle, wide landscape.
